result.stdout:
Fora HLA RTI Console (IEEE 1516-2025 HLA 4 Operator Terminal)

Usage:
  Fora.Rti.Console [options]

Options:
  --connect <url>       Connect to a remote Fora RTI admin server over HTTP or HTTPS.
  --token <key>         Send an admin API key as a Bearer token.
                        Falls back to FORA_RTI_TOKEN.
  --timeout <seconds>   Set the remote HTTP timeout (default: 10).
  -h, --help, -?, /?    Display this help and usage information.

Default Behavior:
  If --connect is omitted, starts in local mode by launching a hosted
  in-process Fora RTI server and opening the TUI console connected to it.
